title: Remove TermAl tests that pass or fail on source-code text or shape instead of behaviour
outcome: TermAl has no test that passes or fails on the text or shape of its own source code: line or byte counts, file, function or module counts, required phrases, module layout, or scans of src/. Every such test is deleted. No replacement static gate is added. Tests that read only their own fixtures, or check observable behaviour, stay. source_id input identity is unaffected.
acceptance: Every TermAl test in Kimi's inventory marked DELETE is removed. The tests the inventory marks KEEP are unchanged, and a recorded read-only search of src/tests and scripts finds no remaining test that reads repository source files and asserts on their text, shape or size.
No new static gate, lint or wrapper over the same metric is added, and no product code is changed beyond what removing those tests requires, such as dropping now-unused test-only helpers.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: Removed the inventoried repository-source text and shape tests while preserving fixture, runtime, rendered and compiler assertions. The 19-path cleanup landed in 832e65e6. The first post-landing evaluation found a missed checked-in workflow-text test; the deletion-only 0bda522c correction landed on master with a clean independent review pair and verified exact-tree DL560 FULL test-bc889b22. Fresh independent post-landing evaluation 21645a3e550f454182cfb859d74a2f4b passed all three criteria on clean 0bda522c/4bb2530e. Exact registered planner check passed 15/15. No replacement static gate, product logic change, or R3 install.
